final_hook: Your voice matters. Help shape Vanna's future.
body:
[Day 5 · Discord, Telegram, Twitter, Galxe · Community/Feedback]

We're building Vanna for you. Your voice matters! Join our growing community on Discord & Telegram. Share your insights, provide feedback, and help us build the most resilient infrastructure against regulatory shifts. Complete our new feedback quest on Galxe! #VannaCommunity #BuildWithUs

CTA: Join our Discord & complete the feedback quest on Galxe.
Incentive: Galxe points for providing feedback, recognition within the community.
KPI: Discord/Telegram member growth, number of feedback submissions via Galxe.
Gate: BLOCKED —
